newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cancels salmon talks with Canada.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cancels salmon talks with Canada.

text.p: The United States on Tuesday canceled the next round of negotiations with Canada over salmon fishing after Canada seized four American fishing trawlers.

In a statement, the State Department said negotiations over dwindling salmon stocks in the Pacific Northwest that had been scheduled to resume on Friday were postponed "until a more favorable climate for discussions can be achieved."
Canada and the United States have skirmished for years over salmon catches and pressure for a deal is mounting before this year's salmon run begins in the next few weeks.

One week ago, the Canadians angrily halted talks when U.S. negotiators said they were not authorised to offer a specific catch reduction at the session. Canada is concerned about overfishing by American boats as salmon head through Alaskan waters into Canadian waters to breed.

After the talks collapsed, Canada began enforcing a regulation that requires all U.S. fishing boats passing through its waters on their way to fishing grounds to report to Canadian authorities and stow their fishing gear. A total of four U.S. trawlers have been halted off the coast so far and their crews arrested.
The United States "is not closing the door on other actions" to respond to the Canadian seizure of the fishing boats, the State Department official said.
